what: ROADMAP #267/#268/#269/#270 — how often the position is running a clock the seed dropped

floors.volatiles: FLOOR. The store records no |-start| at all, so a Taunt/Encore/Disable is countable only from the CLICK that caused it. Any other source — an item, an ability, a move whose secondary applies one — is invisible. The live board sees all of them.
floors.terrain: CEILING, and kept out of the headline. A terrain's duration is not in the tag artifact and reading it would mean opening a Dex, which is what keeps this scan honest. The figure is the share of decision points AFTER a terrain was set, never expired.
floors.hazardRemoval: CEILING. Rapid Spin / Mortal Spin / Defog / Tidy Up are counted from the `removesHazards` tag; a grounded Poison type ABSORBING Toxic Spikes on entry is not, because it needs the body's types and therefore a Dex.
floors.statusCures: CEILING. The store records a status LANDING and never a cure, so a Heal Bell, a Lum Berry, a Natural Cure pivot and a thaw all leave the body counted as still statused.
floors.decisions: AND ALL OF IT IS A CEILING ON DECISIONS: it counts positions the seed described wrongly, not argmaxes that flip.
